resources.string: Appendix at the cecum and an enlarged cross-section through its wall
The base of the appendix joins the cecum, the first pouch of the large intestine.
The appendix ends blindly. Its position and curvature can vary.
The narrow inner space opens into the cecum at the base and ends at the closed tip.
Lymphoid follicles cluster in the mucosa and submucosa around the lumen. Some have pale germinal centers.
The muscularis externa surrounds the inner wall. Its outer longitudinal muscle forms a continuous layer here.
